mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES rebounds while TRANSIT stabilizes, weekday commuter traffic shifts back into shopping corridors and lifts RETAIL_REC within four weeks. The signal fails if workplace visits remain weak or transit usage keeps falling despite the rebound.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -23.1 at t-1w to -10.4 at t-0w while TRANSIT recovered from -17.7 to -12.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES turns less negative for two consecutive weeks and TRANSIT does not deteriorate further.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in PARKS mobility crowds out discretionary shopping trips in the following week as households substitute outdoor leisure for retail visits. This mechanism predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks when PARKS stays elevated above recent levels.
candidate_trigger: PARKS exceeds 60 for at least one weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from 46.9 at t-2w to 67.0 at t-1w and remained 63.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 7 days after PARKS remains above 60, or PARKS stays elevated without a subsequent drop in retail mobility.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC move in opposite directions, the area is shifting spending toward essentials, which suppresses discretionary retail visits over the next two weeks. The effect weakens if grocery mobility falls back below baseline or retail is supported by commuting.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed positive at 10.7, 11.7, 6.6, 11.0 while RETAIL_REC stayed negative at -9.0, -7.6, -11.9, -8.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above baseline in most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in TRANSIT below recent levels signals tighter movement frictions that reduce casual shopping access and depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks. The prediction fails if transit recovers without a retail drag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -15 for two consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -11.4, -13.1, -17.7, -12.0 over the four observed weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT stays below -15 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of higher RESIDENTIAL time and lower WORKPLACES indicates more time spent near home, which shifts purchases to remote or local essentials and lowers destination retail visits within two weeks. The mechanism fails if people stay home more but still increase shopping trips.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL turned slightly positive at t-1w while WORKPLACES fell to -23.1 before partially recovering
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 14 days when RESIDENTIAL is above baseline and WORKPLACES is below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS stays unusually high while RETAIL_REC has already dipped, the area is in a warm-weather leisure pattern that delays mall and high-street trips until the next month. The effect appears over four weeks and weakens when park use normalizes.
candidate_trigger: PARKS stays above 55 for at least three consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was above 48 in all weeks and reached 67.0 and 63.1 in the last two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though PARKS remains above 55 across at least three consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed rise in WORKPLACES after a weak week creates a lagged spillover into lunch and after-work shopping, lifting RETAIL_REC one week later. This mechanism fails if workplace mobility does not stay above the recent trough or if retail does not follow with a short lag.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by more than 8 points week-on-week from a negative trough
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded from -23.1 at t-1w to -10.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not higher in the next 7 days after WORKPLACES posts a week-on-week increase greater than 8 points from a negative level.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain depressed, the city is still operating under a constrained movement regime that suppresses discretionary shopping trips over the next month. Retail recovery requires at least one of those channels to normalize; otherwise RETAIL_REC stays below its recent average.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed negative in every week and WORKPLACES was below baseline in every week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below baseline throughout most of that period.
